title: 第14章 老板，你是不是爱上我了？
slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

温以染想起这个问题之前她就跟沈瑶讨论过。

结论是：没一个敢再要她。

当时她的回答是：所以啊，不能让人知道。

傅临渊问她这个是什么意思？

她细品这句话：他在炫耀？不对，他在威胁！

想清楚以后，温以染脸上恰当地显出强烈惊恐：“老板，别……别告诉他们。”

傅临渊松开手，满意欣赏着她惊慌失措的样子：“你怕什么？”

温以染：“他们要是知道了你——”

“你以为他们敢动我？”傅临渊挑眉。

温以染：“不敢，但他们会让我活不下去......”

没有钱，她可不就活不下去。

温以染小心翼翼挽他胳膊，柔声细语：“所以，别让他们知道，行不行？”

傅临渊面无表情：“你最好把腿闭紧了，不准让他们碰你。还有——”

傅临渊顿了一下，再次强调：“碰哪儿也不行，懂？”

温以染睁大眼，像是第一次认识他，看他的目光像X光，嗖嗖的。

傅临渊皱眉，“你这是什么表情？”

“好强的独占欲！”温以染惊叹，一脸陶醉，“你让我心跳好快！”

“老板，你是不是爱上我了？”

傅临渊嘴角抽了一下，“少恶心我。”

温以染继续表演，“那肯定也快了，要不怎么会这么在乎我。”

傅临渊忍无可忍：“闭嘴。”

温以染心里直夸自己，这演技，当初真该考北影中戏，简直浪费了天生的表演细胞。

达到目的后，她捡起地上的衣服。

Page (1/3)

Wen Yiran remembered that she had discussed this issue with Shen Yao before.

The conclusion is: No one dares to want her again.

Her answer at that time was: So, no one can know.

Fu Linyuan asked her what she meant?

She studied this sentence carefully: Is he showing off?No, he's threatening!

After thinking about it clearly, Wen Yiran's face appropriately showed strong panic: "Boss, don't... don't tell them."

Fu Linyuan let go of his hand and admired her panicked look with satisfaction: "What are you afraid of?"

Wen Yiran: "If they know about you——"

"Do you think they dare to touch me?" Fu Linyuan raised his eyebrows.

Wen Yiran: "I don't dare, but they will make it difficult for me to live..."

Without money, she wouldn't be able to survive.

Wen Yiran carefully held his arm and whispered softly: "So, don't let them know, okay?"

Fu Linyuan was expressionless: "You'd better close your legs tightly and don't let them touch you. And -"

Fu Linyuan paused and emphasized again: "You can't touch anywhere, understand?"

Wen Yiran opened his eyes wide, as if meeting him for the first time, looking at him like an X-ray, whooshing.

Fu Linyuan frowned, "What's your expression?"

"What a strong desire for exclusivity!" Wen Yiran exclaimed, with a look of intoxication on his face, "You make my heart beat so fast!"

"Boss, are you in love with me?"

Fu Linyuan's mouth twitched, "Don't disgust me."

Wen Yiran continued to perform, "It must be soon, otherwise you wouldn't care about me so much."

Fu Linyuan couldn't bear it anymore: "Shut up."

Wen Yiran praised himself in his heart. With his acting skills, he really should have been admitted to Beijing Film and Television University. It was a waste of his natural acting skills.

After achieving her goal, she picked up the clothes on the ground.
